title: 化学反応論
subtitle: Chemistry of Phase and Reaction
teachers:
SAKAMOTO Muneaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
After completing this course, you will be able to:
1. Explain the foundations of phase diagrams.
2. Explain the theories of chemical kinetics.
3. Perform calculations using chemical kinetics with the thermodynamic concepts.
4. Recognize the value of chemical kinetics in our local and global situation.
advice: Chemistry of Phase and Reactions is a foundation course for School of Applied Chemistry, also highly related to Laboratory course on sophomore and junior. The course is designed to help build a foundation of Chemical Kinetics, Chemical equilibrium, and Phase diagram. Through the course, these foundations will be described from the view of thermodynamics (e.g. the concept of enthalpy, entropy, and Gibb's free energy). At the end of the course, you can solve single answer problems using these foundations.
books:
Textbooks: Peter Atkins and Julio de Paula (2020), Elements of Physical Chemistry Seventh Edition 7th Ed. (In Japanese)
Reference Books: Haruaki Tazaki (2000), Thermodynamics (In Japanese)
Reserved Books in the Library: not applicable
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physics, and math are required. B008-01 "Chemical Thermodynamics" with a grade of B or better.

activityGoals.body: You will be able to describe three states of matter and phase shift.
You will be able to explain the foundations of phase diagrams.
You will be able to describe the reaction rate in terms of the Arrhenius equation.
You will be able to determine the effect of temperature on rates using the collision model.
You will be able to Perform calculations using chemical kinetics with the thermodynamic concepts.

achievementLevels.ideal:
At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to:
- Write equilibrium constant expression for given reactions
- Describe factors that affect reaction rates.
- Solve complex problems using the three laws of thermodynamics and perform calculations with the relevant functions, including enthalpy, entropy, and Gibbs free energy.
- Simulate a reaction speed for a reaction to a given pressure and temperature conditions
achievementLevels.standard:
At the conclusion of this course, you will be able to:
- Write equilibrium constant expression for given reactions
- List factors that affect reaction rates.
- Solve simple problems using the Gibbs free energy relationships.
- Simulate a reaction speed for a reaction to a given pressure and temperature conditions

              After completing this course, you will be able to:
1. Explain the foundations of phase diagrams.
2. Explain the theories of chemical kinetics.
3. Perform calculations using chemical kinetics with the thermodynamic concepts.
4. Recognize the value of chemical kinetics in our local and global situation.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Chemistry of Phase and Reactions is a foundation course for School of Applied Chemistry, also highly related to Laboratory course on sophomore and junior. The course is designed to help build a foundation of Chemical Kinetics, Chemical equilibrium, and Phase diagram. Through the course, these foundations will be described from the view of thermodynamics (e.g. the concept of enthalpy, entropy, and Gibb's free energy). At the end of the course, you can solve single answer problems using these foundations.
